# DLF CONSUMER BRANDS

 Deer Creek Seed by DLF, a premier seed outlet backed by the global leader in seed research production, offers top-quality forage, turf, cover crop, and food plot seeds to U.S. consumers who enjoy easy ordering, fast shipping and dedicated support. 

 Founded in 2004, X-Seed® by DLF has evolved from coir-based lawn patches to a premium range of lawn, pasture, and wildflower seeds. Leveraging DLF’s expertise, X-Seed® offers innovative, low-maintenance solutions with high durability, disease resistance, and enhanced growth. 

 ForageMax® by DLF offers a range of high-performance forage grasses and legumes tested for palatability, yield, persistency, and quality in North American climates. Our science-based approach ensures superior nutrition and economic benefits for milk and livestock production. 

 Mastergreen® by DLF provides a science-driven approach for sustainable landscapes, delivering exceptional results for lawns and sports fields. Its 4-N-1 technology promotes quicker germination and strong root development, optimizing nutrition and water utilization for healthy seedlings. 

 4Most Seed Enhancement by DLF is an eco-friendly solution for turf and forage, combining slow-release nitrogen, beneficial microbes, and a biodegradable moisture-retaining starch. It enhances seed performance, promotes faster growth, and reduces the need for additional fertilizers. 

 Microclover® is a small-leaved white clover that grows between turf grasses, naturally supplying nitrogen and creating a dense, resilient turf. It reduces fertilizer needs, enhances wear tolerance, and thrives in diverse conditions, offering a sustainable, cost-effective turf solution.

# Seeds are everywhere, So are we

 What do kids, football stars and cows have in common? They cannot do without our high-quality turf and forage grass. It all begins with a seed 

As you might have guessed, we are into grass. Where others hardly notice the green grass underneath their feet, we see a plant that is easy to take for granted - yet difficult to be without. That is why we are proud to be one of the world’s leading turf and forage seed companies.

However, there is more to us than grass. We are also dedicated to a wide range of other species like clovers, alfalfa, forage brassicas, herbs, fodder, sugar beets, cover crops, seed potatoes, vegetable seeds and flower seeds. 

On this page, you can get to know us better and explore how we make a difference together. Seed by seed.

## Leading in a number of ways

- Owned by Danish grass-seed farmers and headquartered in Denmark
- Provide locally adjusted products to more than 100 countries
- Global market leader in forage and turf seed for the temperate climate zone 
- More than 1,800 employees across 19 countries

## Find the seeds that will grow your business

 Thanks to our extensive focus on Research & Development, you can find grasses for every local need. To ease your search, we divide our seeds into three segments offering very different advantages. Because grass isn’t just grass. 

## Our more than 1,800 colleagues are reliable, productive and highly innovative. Just like our products.

 - Søren Halbye, CEO at DLF 

## Seeds for a sustainable future

 Our most important task is to breed and innovate more sustainable products. From the forage grasses that help cows produce more milk with reduced impact on the environment to the lawn grasses that thrive in drought areas with almost no need for irrigation. So while you might not see it, the grass is getting greener – and we are just getting started. 

## Innovating small seeds with big benefits

 Global hunger. Global warming. A global cry for action. Today, we need crop solutions adapted to more extreme conditions that can also help reduce the climate footprint left by human activities. This isn’t easy, but we are up for the challenge. As one of the world’s leading seed companies, developing products that address resilience and resource-efficiency challenges is the core of our business. The result is next level plant breeding that helps you and people all over the world to take the next step in a more sustainable direction.

- Alfalfa

 Matching cool‑season grass varieties to alfalfa’s Reproductive Maturity (RM) is essential to preserving yield and forage quality in mixed stands. DLF’s Forage Maturity Index standardizes maturity ratings across species, helping producers choose grasses—such as orchardgrass, tall fescue, meadow fescue, timothy, festulolium, and perennial ryegrass—that align with alfalfa’s first‑cut harvest timing. Newer “late” or “early” varieties prevent grasses from maturing too far ahead or behind alfalfa. This system, supported by ongoing university–industry collaboration, gives producers a practical tool for selecting varieties that synchronize growth and optimize total‑forage performance. ## WE ENRICH LAND,

## LIFE, AND PEOPLE

## THROUGH SEEDS

AND SCIENCE EMBRACING CHANGE AND LOOKING TO THE FUTURE At DLF, we believe in the transformative power of seeds and science to create better future. As a farmer-owned cooperative with deep roots, expert know how, and global presence, we are uniquely positioned to lead the change in addressing the challenges of climate change and biodiversity loss through our product solutions and their productivity. Our purpose "We enrich land, life and people through seeds and science" captures the heart of who we are and what we aim to achieve. A LEGACY OF COLLABORATION AND INNOVATION Founded on traditions of cooperation, DLF has grown from a local Danish seed producer to a global leader in forage and turf seed. Guided by the collective dedication of our farm-owners and suppliers, we bring locally adapted seed solutions to over 100 countries. Our heritage ensures business resilience, and our forward-looking mindset drives innovation. We see the world's challenges not as obstacles, but as opportunities to make a difference. By blending science with sustainability we aim to create products and solutions that go beyond profitability, contributing to ecosystems, and communities.

SEEDS AS CATALYSTS FOR A GREEN TRANSITION Seeds are a catalyst of the green transition. They are simple, essential, scalable, and regenerative. Through plant breeding and scientific research, our seeds work both above and below the ground to deliver dual-purpose solutions that address critical issues. Above the ground innovative seeds enable biomass production and quality of leaves, enhance biodiversity and tolerance to disease, and stabilize landscapes through erosion control. Below the ground our roots enable carbon capture, improve soil health, reduce nutrient loss, and foster stable, resilient ecosystems. As global market leaders, we invest in future growth levers to build seeds for a changing climate and use our expertise to unfold future opportunities for businesses and people.

ENRICHING LAND, LIFE, AND PEOPLE DLF's commitment to innovation enriches ecosystems and enhances quality of life for all living organisms. By leveraging our local knowledge and global presence, we bring green surroundings and climate-resilient solutions to people and communities.

THE POWER OF COLLABORATION Our purpose is grounded in DLF's cooperative model and a deep-rooted belief that collaboration is the path forward. By uniting farmers, scientists, and businesses, we unlock the full potential of seeds to drive positive change. Together, we are more than a seed supplier - we are partners in transformation, empowering our sector and communities to thrive.

A FUTURE GROUNDED IN PURPOSE DLF's long-term purpose strengthens us as a company with a significant societal and environmental impact. The phrase "We enrich land, life and people through seeds and science" reflects our commitment to creating a bettor future. It is a story of passion, potential, and positivity. As we continue to lead the seed sector, we remain dedicated to bridge the past and the future, tradition and innovation, local presence, and global impact.

WE WORK WITH NATURE AND SCIENCE TO BRING RESILIENT SEED SOLUTIONS FOR LAND, LIFE AND PEOPLE.

## LEADER IN

SUSTAINABLE SOLUTIONS INVESTING IN THE FUTURE DLF’s state-of-the-art seed enhancement and production facility in the Willamette Valley was built to support the company’s expanding market needs. Covering 141,000 square feet, the facility boasts an automated seed enhancement line, high-speed blending and packaging, and 85,000 square feet of storage space for raw materials and finished goods. The new facility features end-to-end automation, allowing raw seed to travel pneumatically through the system, enhancing efficiency and precision. The facility’s advanced technology also enables real-time data monitoring, ensuring consistent quality throughout the production process while requiring less physical labor. This investment not only strengthens DLF’s operational capacity but also positions the company as a leader in sustainable agricultural solutions. The transition to reusable totes for moving raw seed from the fields to the facility, for example, is helping to cut plastic waste in seed transportation. Moreover, the addition of a cutting-edge seed enhancement line makes it possible to address turf and forage needs more effectively and sustainably, replacing chemistry with biology to help seedlings thrive and become healthy and resilient plants.
